source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary:
When this model is destroyed for the first time, roll a D6 as that phase ends. On a 2+, return it to the battlefield:

- with its full wounds
- as near as it can be to the spot where it was destroyed
- outside Engagement Range of every enemy unit

reminder.unresolved: Withheld as a class: independent reviews found 4 of 86 sampled reminders of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, above the 2% this reading may ship with.

setBackUp.placement: as close as possible to where destroyed, not within Engagement Range of enemy units
